lines: The meeting hosted by the UFS's Secret Service Agency G had been rough going from the outset.
The self-styled Gangster, Kanzaki Juubei, had declared this before all concerned:
「Sorry, but I got no plans to team up with anyone.」
Siren from Secret Service Agency G was momentarily stunned by that overly brazen manner of speaking, and then raised her voice indignantly.
「What did you say?! Then what did you come all the way to Yomihara for?!」
「Tekkain-dono?! What is the meaning of this?!」
He grinned, and the focus of her anger turned to Kaworu.
「I kept my promise. My promise to invite Juubei to the meeting, that is.」
「I wasn't asked to convince him on your behalf as well.」
Kaworu looked like she wasn't concerned at all.
She had incurred a debt to Cabinet Intelligence over allowing the twin oni they had placed in her care to be broken out of prison.
For that reason, she had been forced to convey to Juubei a proposal for an alliance from Secret Service Agency G, which had a friendly relationship with Cabinet Intelligence.
Given his personality, Kaworu had known from the start that he was never going to accept such a proposal.
「Are you telling me that you attended our secret meeting just as a kind of “window shopping”?!」
「I got no interest in whatever you guys're doing. I'll just plain forget about today.」
「Oi oi, you the type to always go straight to the hotel on the first date? Didn't look like that kinda girl.」
「It's a common story, right? You ask someone out on a date 'cuz they're a pretty good catch, but then they're not as great as you thought, so you cut it short.」
「It's basically that. I gave meetin' you guys a go. Then, I decided against forming an alliance. That's what it boils down to.」
Even the Phantom Witch, who had been watching the pair's exchange, began to chuckle.
Siren shot to her feet, enraged by the air he had, which seemed like he was making a mockery of the meeting itself.
Siren's underlings, UFS special forces soldiers who had been waiting on standby, surrounded Juubei.
He didn't change the look on his face one iota.
Without a word, Yuri blocked the way in front of the soldiers and took a stance to protect him, but
「I don't think much of your short temper, cyborg lady.」
After making a classic “cool guy” face at her that said, 「No need to worry,」 he had her stand down.
Kaworu and the Phantom Witch had faces which said they were unconcerned, or more than that, that they were enjoying this.
Siren glared at those two in apparent irritation, but naturally, it looked like she had no intention of making this three against one.
